scripts.start: npm run build && node --use-env-proxy --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx apps/server/src/main.ts
scripts.dev: npm run build && node --use-env-proxy --env-file-if-exists=.env --watch --import tsx apps/server/src/main.ts
scripts.engine:verify:rooms: npm run build && npm run engine:check-definitions && node --import tsx scripts/verify-native-runtime.mjs
scripts.engine:verify:recovery: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/verify-native-recovery.mjs
scripts.engine:verify:selection: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/verify-native-selection.mjs
scripts.engine:verify:lightweight: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/verify-lightweight.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run format:check
